description: Land Acquisition - Agulugaha, Imaduwa D/S Division, Galle District - Giddawa, Medadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific orders for taking possession of described land parcels, including detailed descriptions of the land locations, boundaries, and extents. The mention of the Minister of Lands is incidental to the land acquisition process and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government-related classification.
